name: coffee
title: Coffee
description: Prevent the sleep function on your computer
author: mooxl

commands.name: caffeinateWhile
commands.title: Caffeinate While
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Prevent your computer from sleeping while a certain app is running

commands.name: index
commands.title: Caffeinate Status Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Get the status of the current caffeination in your menu bar

commands.name: caffeinateFor
commands.title: Caffeinate for ...
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Prevent your computer from sleeping for a certain time

commands.name: caffeinateUntil
commands.title: Caffeinate Until
commands.subtitle: Coffee
commands.description: Prevent your computer from sleeping until a certain time. Type one like 5pm, or leave the field empty to pick a date and time.

tools.name: caffeinate-for
tools.title: Caffeinate for Duration
tools.description: Keeps your computer awake for a specified duration

tools.name: caffeinate
tools.title: Caffeinate
tools.description: Keep computer awake for unspecified duration

tools.name: check-caffeination-status
tools.title: Check Caffeination Status
tools.description: Check if your computer is currently caffeinated or not

tools.name: decaffeinate
tools.title: Decaffeinate
tools.description: Turn off your computer's sleep prevention

tools.name: schedule-caffeination
tools.title: Schedule Caffeination
tools.description: Add a schedule for your caffeination using AI

tools.name: caffeinate-while-app-is-running
tools.title: Caffeinate While App Is Running
tools.description: While an app is running, turn on caffeination.

tools.name: caffeinate-until
tools.title: Caffeinate Until
tools.description: Keep the computer awake until a specific future date and time

tools.name: list-caffeination-schedules
tools.title: List Caffeination Schedules
tools.description: List the recurring caffeination schedules configured for the week

tools.name: manage-caffeination-schedule
tools.title: Manage Caffeination Schedule
tools.description: Pause, resume, or delete a recurring caffeination schedule for a day

preferences.name: preventDisk
preferences.description: Prevent the disk from sleeping. This option is not supported on Windows and will have no effect
preferences.label: Prevent disk sleep

preferences.name: icon
preferences.description: Select icon set for Menu Bar. macOS only
preferences.title: Menu Bar Icon

preferences.name: startCaffeinateOnLaunch
preferences.description: Automatically keep your computer awake (indefinitely) when Raycast starts. Requires the Caffeinate Status command (15 s interval) or the Caffeinate Status Menu Bar command (1 m interval) to be enabled (on macOS)
preferences.label: Start caffeination when Raycast starts

preferences.name: decaffeinatePausesSchedules
preferences.description: When enabled, decaffeinating while a schedule is running will automatically pause the schedule instead of asking you to pause it first
preferences.label: Decaffeinate pauses running schedules

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
